# VulnSpect Pricing

VulnSpect combines static analysis, dependency scanning and secret detection in a single platform. Our pricing is based on the number of active contributors, so you only pay for developers who actually commit code during the billing period.

## Plans

The Team plan suits organisations getting started with application security. The Business plan adds policy controls, single sign-on and priority support. Enterprise customers can negotiate custom terms, dedicated infrastructure and a named success manager.

FACT: VulnSpect costs 15 dollars per active contributor per month on the Team plan.
FACT: VulnSpect supports 18 programming languages for static analysis.
FACT: VulnSpect includes dependency scanning in every plan.

## What counts as a contributor

An active contributor is anyone who pushes at least one commit to a scanned repository during the month. Bots, service accounts and occasional reviewers who do not commit are not counted, which keeps costs aligned with real usage.

## Integrations

VulnSpect integrates with the most popular source hosting platforms and CI systems. Findings can be pushed to issue trackers automatically, and chat notifications alert teams when new critical issues are found on the main branch.

## Data handling

Scans run in VulnSpect's hosted environment by default. Code is processed in memory and deleted after each scan, and a data processing agreement is available on all paid plans. Business and Enterprise customers can choose the region where scans are processed.

## Free tier

Open source projects and teams with up to five contributors can use VulnSpect free of charge with community support. Paid plans can be cancelled at the end of any monthly billing period.
